title: Chinese smart-battery swap stations can change EV batteries automatically
summary: A short South China Morning Post report on Nio's second-generation automated battery-swap stations for electric vehicles. It notes that Nio had built more than 800 stations in China by early 2022.
why: Linked as concrete evidence that automated EV battery swapping already works at scale in China.

quote.text: the battery is swapped through an automated process in under 5 minutes
